behavioral_effects: ADR-006 (proposed) fixes the sandbox boundary (RemoteSandbox/DockerSandbox, never LocalBackend in the API container), the workspaces model incl. ruleset and auto_approve, per-turn toolkit attachment, approval gating rules, and target-repo process for the coding capability
governance context for agents/backend-api/chat-frontend/mcp-user-connections now lists ADR-006 as a proposed decision constraining work in flight
compatibility_impact: None. Additive: decision index gains ADR-006 (proposed); decision_refs derived onto agents, backend-api, chat-frontend, mcp-user-connections. No schema, API, or config change.
follow_up: Session A: add pydantic-ai-backend, CodingToolkit beside ResearchToolkit, ENABLE_CODING, workspace_id turn flag, frontend toggle; agent-tool skill, agent-evals + security-review
Session B: workspaces table + migration + /api/v1/me/workspaces + proxy handler + sandboxd Compose service under ADR-005 posture; endpoint-fullstack + alembic-migration + compose-check
Session C: SkillsToolset rooted at the workspace's .claude/skills, AGENTS.md injection, governance smoke test with this repository as the first target
Accept ADR-006 (status: accepted) in the session that lands the first write-capable tool, citing this record
limitations: No code changed; the capability does not exist yet. Sessions A (toolkit), B (workspaces + sandbox service), C (skills/AGENTS injection) implement it
Shrink pass: nothing to remove or consolidate; an ADR is a new document by construction, scaffolded by the repository's own decision-propose command
governance-impact reported the ADR path as unassigned (no component owns docs/architecture/decisions), so its validator selection was governance-check only; skills-check was added by judgment
Full governance-check hung once in the OpenAPI exporter subprocess under load (Playwright test-server running) and was killed; the re-run completed in 202s and interfaces.json was untouched
reason: The product was envisioned as a Claude-Code-like coding assistant with RAG attached, but the AssistantAgent has no file, shell, or git tool and no workspace concept, so it cannot perform coding tasks on any repository. ADR-003 and security.json already gate write-capable tools behind deferred approval and require a recorded decision before any write-capable tool source is added; this ADR is that recorded decision, fixing the sandbox boundary (RemoteSandbox/DockerSandbox, never the API container filesystem), the workspace model, and the per-workspace ruleset including auto-approve, before any toolkit code lands.
risks: The ADR reverses Documentation plan decisions 0.11/7.10; if the plan is not amended, Phase 2b will re-record the old decision
Four open questions (private-repo credentials, sandbox egress, quotas, auto-approve lifetime) are deliberately unsettled; Session B Compose work must take the egress decision explicitly
rollback: git revert restores everything; the ADR, index entry, Summary section, and derived decision_refs are all in-tree. Nothing outside the repository is touched. The ~/.claude/plans/Documentation.md amendment note (outside git) would need removing by hand.
security_impact: None in code: this session adds a proposed ADR and the manifests derived from it. The ADR is the recorded human approval that privilege-expansion-requires-approval demands before a write-capable tool source is added in later sessions; no tool surface changes here.
summary: Propose ADR-006: coding workspaces give the assistant sandboxed repository tools under the existing approval model
